data.name: The Inducted
data.detailed_description:
THE INDUCTED

They do not want you to die.
They want to see what you become under pressure.

The Inducted is a third person cooperative arena survival game about surviving staged combat trials inside a rebuilt ancient colosseum.

The Arena was once a place of ritual combat, punishment, and spectacle. It was abandoned for centuries, buried in dust and silence.

Then someone found it.

An advanced faction rebuilt the Arena into a controlled combat machine. Gates seal behind you. Spawn systems wake beneath the floor. Observation tiers fill with people you never see clearly. Every fight is recorded. Every choice is measured.

You are one of The Inducted.

Some were taken without warning. Some chose this for reward, freedom, or someone waiting at home. The Arena does not care why you came. It only cares what you can survive.

FIGHT AS A HERO WITH A PURPOSE

Each hero brings a distinct combat role to the trial.

The Crusader holds the front line with shield, sword, and explosive close range power. The Engineer turns the Arena against itself by placing turrets, locking down choke points, and building defenses before the next wave begins.

More heroes are coming, each designed to change how your team survives.

SURVIVE CONTROLLED TRIALS

The waves are not random. They are staged experiments.

Every gate that opens brings a new test. More enemies. Tighter pressure. Less room for mistakes. The faction is studying how long you last, how quickly you adapt, and what happens when the plan falls apart.

Between trials, use the prep phase to recover, build, reposition, and prepare for the next escalation.

USE THE ARENA AGAINST THEM

The Arena gives you tools, but not mercy.

Activate turret pylons. Place defensive panels. Create choke points. Protect weak angles. Buy your team enough time to survive the next wave.

The faction installed these systems because longer fights create better data.

Use them anyway.

STAND TOGETHER OR BREAK ALONE

Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

The Arena rewards coordination. A shield in the right place can save a teammate. A turret placed before the gates open can turn a collapse into a hold. A bad call can leave everyone surrounded.

The gates do not close.

The trials do not stop.

Someone is always watching.

The Inducted is currently in development. Wishlist now to follow progress.

data.short_description: Co-op PvE arena survival for up to 4 players. Fight escalating enemy waves in a sci-fi colosseum, choose hero classes, place tactical defenses, and survive together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
